_about: Every built-in that is not gated by a capability (docs/spec/16-sandbox.md [sbx.capabilities]) must be listed here, on purpose: a name that computes on its arguments or writes only to the program's own output. A new built-in that is in neither CAPABILITY_OF nor this list fails tests/security/matrix.py, so nothing that touches the machine can be added without someone deciding which it is.
